scientific_integrity: Definitions, scope, proof, limiting cases, and reproducibility program are supplied; mathematical derivation is independent of the finite floating-point checks.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is limited to a two-site equal-variance positive-correlation kernel and homoscedastic observations. It does not characterize all inducing-set objectives or establish a general greedy approximation failure. Earlier specialized priority and independent scientific audit remain unresolved.
title: An exact submodularity phase diagram for two-site variational Gaussian-process pivot gains
